facts_of_case: Wife-petitioner seeking transfer of C.P.No.134 of 2019 from Family Court, Nayagarh to Family Court, Bhubaneswar.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another judge's court if it is convenient for both parties.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submission made on behalf of the wife-petitioner and looking to the financial status of the wife-Petitioner, this Court observes that there would be no difficulty, if the case of the husband gets transferred to the learned Judge, Family Court, Bhubaneswar, rather it would be convenient for both the parties to attend in both the proceedings at one place.

legal_principles.principle: The court may direct the transmission of case records to another judge's court.
legal_principles.held: This Court directs for transfer of the C.P. No.134 of 2019 from the court of learned Judge, Family Court, Nayagarh to the court of learned Judge, Family Court, Bhubaneswar.

outcome.final_order: Case transferred to Family Court, Bhubaneswar; wife-petitioner directed to serve a copy of this order on the learned Judge, Family Court, Nayagarh within seven days hence.
